svg.aria-label: Two stories take turns. Someone searches github readme banner; the phrase drops into the Eco mountain, echoes out and lands in the title of a README, marked checked. Then someone searches web scraping mcp; the phrase web scraping mcp server goes through the mountain and lands in the title tag of a web page, marked checked.

text.tspan: Keyword research for your README and website,
in two Claude Code skills that check their work.
